newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Coupon on IBRD won bonds set at 9.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Coupon on IBRD won bonds set at 9.8 percent.

text.p: The coupon rate on the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) won-denominated bonds has been set at 9.8 percent, The Korea Stock Exchange said on Tuesday.
The won bonds, valued at 95 billion won in issuing principle amount, were launched on April 10 for domestic and overseas markets with payment due by April 23.

The exchange said the bonds would be listed in South Korea's bond market on April 23. The coupon on similar bond issues by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) was set at 10 percent, it said.
Payment for the EBRD's won bonds, estimated at 94.8 billion won, would be completed by May 2, the date for the listing, the exchange said.
The won bonds would be the first won-denominated bond issues by international organisations since the Asian Development Bank (ADB) issued 80 billion won worth of won bonds in September 1995, it said.
